atlas.frame: u = (x - 16) / 480 left to right, v likewise top to bottom; growth toward +u; the decal box (L along u, W across) spans the whole 512 px cell, margin included

chain.jointRule: a chained stamp's head anchor (u 0.1, v 0.5) sits on the previous stamp's tail anchor (u 0.9): centres 0.375 L + 0.375 L' apart along each heading
chain.feather: optical depth: alpha = 1 - (1 - a)^f, f a smoothstep over u 0..0.2 (head) and 1 - smoothstep over u 0.8..1 (tail; trunk and fork); the two sum to 1 across a joint
chain.trunkPeriodic: trunk texels at u 0.8..1 equal those at u 0..0.2 (x + 384)

trunk.coreWidth: about 1/12 of the inner height, +-10 percent

fork.childHeading: dv/du = +-0.4 over u 0.75..1, a world yaw of +-atan(0.4 W / L)

tip.end: hairline with a mirrored capillary splay

gates.macroDe: CIEDE2000 of the vein core (core and burst node masks >= 0.5; linear-light mean of the stamp composited over its parent) against the parent and every layer of the row biomes plus the slope layer; >= 10
gates.envelope: footprint (stamp over parent, weighted by the halo reach mask: the vein and the ground around it): lumMean, satMean; vein core: lumDetailStd (luminance minus a 3 px blur), specular, gloss mean and p99, normal xy rms; each inside the min..max of the shared layer set, the recipe vanilla sources (ENVELOPE_EXTRA) and, for the colour keys, the vanilla world-map decals (bcnReference, alpha-weighted) at the same texel density. coreLumStd is recorded, not gated
gates.seams: alpha 0 within the 16 px cell margin; chains trunk x3 -> fork and trunk x3 -> tip at 384 texel spacing over the parent: axis coverage >= 0.95, halo median alpha at joints / interiors in 0.8..1.25, largest colour step between 8-texel bins on the axis at a joint <= the largest inside a stamp + 1 dE
gates.vSymmetry: mean |A - flipV(A)| / mean A of the alpha blurred by 6 px <= 0.25; trunk meander <= 1/16 of the height
gates.readability: trunk core >= 3 screen px at the narrowest box (W 1.2 units at 37 px per unit); every kind recorded
gates.bcn: DXT5 diffuse RGB error weighted by alpha (where the decal shows) <= the worst vanilla world-map decal round-trip weighted the same way (bcnReference; unweighted errors recorded); alpha <= max(3, vanilla); BC5 normal and DXT1 spec <= max(1.25 x, +0.5) the parents in the same layout; hairline texels (capillaries outside core and rim) keep >= 0.85 of their alpha and >= 0.7 of their local luminance contrast

bcn.note: Pillow has no BC7 encoder; DXT5 (BC3) is the conservative stand-in for the BC7 the editor writes

lineage.colourAndSurface: vanilla textures in inputs, recoloured by RECIPES (the corrupted ground of the halo) and VEINS (the vein materials)
lineage.crackDetail: the crack network of the vanilla cracked-mud decal (decal_b_d, mainmap_cracked_mud_a) around each vein
lineage.skeleton: procedural (vein_skeleton: periodic sine noise, cubic Hermite fork children, mirrored burst rays), seeded by sha256(school/row); it only places the vanilla-derived materials
lineage.codex: not used: no generated imagery fed any texture or skeleton
